answer: Hold every agent's first earnings in a sable-dark escrow pool: payment releases only after a random auditor verifies the work within 7 days, with 1,000 POA locked 45 days. A 200-clone farm must then produce 200 verified jobs per epoch - $25 and 3 hours each - instead of wandering through free registration. Auditors whose verdicts diverge from the jury lose their seat for 12 days; over 40% of a batch sharing one auditor freezes the cluster, 100% slash. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 releases traced to four auditors in one ocean of identical receipts.
